text:
lina: Kickoff for Aurora joint rack perf/W + kernel-tune next week. Scope: rack-level watt, tokens/s, and one kernel tuning pass in Aurora lab. Need run matrix, telemetry schema, and PDU plan.

rick: Proposed minimal matrix: models [redwood-3b, redwood-7b], quants [fp16,int8], batch [1,4], seq [512,1024], runs=3. Capture rack_power_w and gpu_power_w.

tanya: I can own telemetry + CSV. Will export per-run CSV + a consolidated summary. Will include columns: run_id,model,quant,batch,seq,avg_gpu_w,rack_w,tokens_s,p95_ms,energy_j_per_token,peak_kv_bytes.

aaron: Prom exporter labels: lab,rack_id,pdu_channel,model,quant,run_id. Metrics: gpu_power_w,rack_power_w,tokens_total,latency_ms_bucket,kv_cache_bytes. PromQL snippet for energy/token: `sum(rate(rack_power_w[1m])) / sum(rate(tokens_total[1m]))`.

lina: Aurora requires kernel blobs stay in their lab; legal confirmed coop NDA but no artifacts leave. We'll do baseline -> tuneA -> final. Raj from Aurora asked for a 10-day tuning window.

rick: Standard run command to pin in runbook:
```
./aurbench --model redwood-7b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --quant int8 --iters 3 --warmup 10 --rack-measure --out s3://partners/aurora/3505554321/
```

bench-bot: CI smoke: 2/3 runs OK, 1 failure due to PDU read timeout on pdu_channel 2. Logs at s3://bench/aurora/3505554321/logs.tar.gz. Artifacts uploaded.

tanya: Noted PDU flake. Will add `--pdu-retry 4` and `--kv-flush` between iterations. I'll push telemetry schema to GH issue today.

aaron: Also emit peak_kv_bytes so we can correlate OOMs. I'll add exporter change tomorrow AM and include the PromQL example in the runbook.

lina: Action items: tanya telemetry (EOD), aaron exporter + PromQL (tomorrow), rick runbook + PR (today), coordinate Aurora lab window (today). Weekly sync scheduled Friday 3505557921 to decide canary timing and marketing blurb. Thanks all.
